text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, niCARdipine hydrochloride 25 mg/10 mL vials are not on the FDA drug shortage list. Our labeled manufacturer is Chengdu Shuode Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd, which received an NAI inspection on 2025-05-22. Current inventory provides limited days of supply across three sites. Corvale East holds 222 units at 13.2 units per day for 17 days. Corvale General holds 226 units at 14.4 units per day for 16 days. Corvale Lakeside holds 86 units at 3.1 units per day for 28 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show niCARdipine hydrochloride is not listed on the shortage list as of 2026-10-21. The labeled manufacturer Chengdu Shuode Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd received an NAI inspection on 2025-05-22.

Our position: Supply is constrained but not classified as a shortage by FDA. We must secure additional sources before inventory falls below safety stock at Corvale East and Corvale General.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from Caplin Steriles Limited (plant NAI 2024-08-09); requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to initiate purchase from Cipla USA Inc. (plants VAI 2023-01-27 and VAI 2024-07-25); requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to initiate purchase from Lifestar Pharma LLC (plant VAI 2022-11-25); requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to initiate purchase from Qilu Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (plant VAI 2023-05-19); requires P&T committee approval.
5. Buyer to initiate purchase from Sagent Pharmaceuticals (plant QILU PHARM HAINAN); requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement until a formal FDA shortage listing appears.
